title: A receipt
description:
Read three items, each a quantity (whole number) and a price (with decimals), and print a receipt with the columns lined up:

For the input

```
2 1.50
1 12.99
10 0.25
```

print

```
  2 x   1.50 =   3.00
  1 x  12.99 =  12.99
 10 x   0.25 =   2.50
Total:          18.49
```

- The quantity is 3 characters wide, the price and line total 6 wide with 2 decimals: `"%3d x %6.2f = %6.2f\n"`.
- The total line is `Total:` and the sum, as `"Total: %14.2f\n"`.
- Read with `scanf("%d %lf", &quantity, &price)`: `%lf` for a `double`.
hints: A `for` loop (lesson 2.01) repeats three times: `for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) { ... }`. Or simply write the reading and printing three times.
